elements.label: Agent Builder UI screen shrinking into a rounded card

sfx_review.label: music
sfx_review.note: Broadband pulse matching the regular beat pulses of the music bed; nothing visual happens at 84.11 s, before the burst.

sfx_review.label: unsure
sfx_review.note: Low-mid tonal band brightening at 85.07 s after the motion has settled, under 'watching.'; could be a soft chime or a music swell, no visual hit to sync to.

pattern.description: The full-bleed screen recording shrinks (about 6%) into a rounded-corner card floating on a dark purple starfield, decelerating to rest as the narrator says 'Thanks for watching'.
pattern.why_premium: Turning the raw UI capture into a framed card on the brand backdrop signals the end of the demo and gives a polished, contained exit rather than a hard cut to the outro.

build_hint.gsap: Brand starfield background behind a UI container; gsap.fromTo(uiPlate, {scale: 1, borderRadius: 0}, {scale: 0.94, borderRadius: 24, duration: 0.35, ease: 'power3.out'}); optionally add a soft drop shadow as it lands.
build_hint.remotion: Inside an AbsoluteFill with the gradient background: const s = spring({frame: frame - start, fps, config: {damping: 30, stiffness: 180, mass: 1}}); scale = interpolate(s, [0, 1], [1, 0.94]); borderRadius = interpolate(s, [0, 1], [0, 24]); no overshoot.

notes: Continuation of e026 (same shrink; the shot detector split it). camera.move is none, so treated as the plate scaling inside the frame, not a camera pull-out. Energy is front-loaded and decays smoothly, suggesting a strong ease-out.
